svg.title: Pairwise allele support, weighted voting and phasing entropy
svg.text: Allele-pair support between u and v
Vote rule for the pair (u, v)
one pairing < 1 unit, the other ≥ 1 → weight 20, any s
voter u is a tandem-repeat indel → weight 0.1
Weighted votes from up to k = 35 upstream variants
4 votes rest on one read (P + Q ≤ 1)
from votes with s < 0.2, weight ≥ 1, non-indel voter only
Phasing entropy PE = − Σ pi log2 pi
PS = position of the first variant of the block
